description: Complete the AI Insights configuration for a revenue dashboard.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this configuration will:
1. Select a foundation model approved for Free Edition
2. Set a refresh cadence matching business hours
3. Provide context the AI uses to interpret the chart
4. Constrain the insight to avoid leaking sensitive columns
5. Surface anomalies only above a meaningful threshold
codeTemplate:
-- AI Insights configuration for a revenue dashboard widget
-- AI Insights auto-generate a text summary of the chart's notable patterns

ai_insights_config = {
    # Foundation model used to generate the summary
    # Free Edition approved: databricks-llama-3.1-8b-instruct
    'model': '__BLANK_0__',

    # Refresh cadence: regenerate the insight every N hours
    'refresh_cadence_hours': __BLANK_1__,

    # Plain-English context the AI uses to interpret the chart
    'context': (
        'This chart shows net revenue by month. ' +
        '__BLANK_2__ metrics: gross_revenue minus discount_amount minus returns. ' +
        'A drop > 10% month-over-month is significant.'
    ),

    # Column allowlist: only use these columns in the insight
    'allowed_columns': ['order_date', 'net_revenue', 'region'],

    # Anomaly threshold: only flag if deviation exceeds this %
    'anomaly_threshold_pct': __BLANK_3__,

    # Output format: 'paragraph' (default) or 'bullets'
    'format': '__BLANK_4__'
}
hints: Free Edition allows only specific foundation models on Model Serving — pick one of the databricks-llama-* family
Refreshing insights every 6 hours balances freshness with compute cost
Net revenue is gross minus discounts minus returns — be explicit so the AI uses the right column
A 10% threshold catches real anomalies without flagging normal variance
Bullets are more scannable than paragraphs for chart summaries
learnings: AI Insights use Foundation Model Serving under the hood
Context strings directly influence insight quality
Column allowlists prevent leaking sensitive data in summaries
Format choice affects how readable the summary is
